purpose: Record the trivia_qa -> squad OOD numbers alongside the reconciliation, and state why a same-checkpoint recompute (Step 6) is not executable.

internal_consistency.note: Within the OOD run, the id_test and ood columns ARE mutually consistent: they use the same trained arm model, the same training-data transform, and the same code path. The domain drop is therefore internally valid when read within this file.
internal_consistency.headline_finding_unchanged: OOD, z (0.6215) approx z_q_resp (0.6182): the in-domain text advantage does not transfer; the hidden-state feature is the domain-robust signal.

step6_same_checkpoint_ood_reeval.reason: Step 6 requires the same checkpoint from Step 5. No checkpoint is saved by any run (no torch.save in amortized_ue/stage2/), so the OOD numbers cannot be recomputed from the exact model that produced the main-run 0.795. The existing ood_results_squad.json is already internally self-consistent (id_test and ood share one trained model).
step6_same_checkpoint_ood_reeval.implication_for_thesis: Report the OOD drop using THIS run's own internally-consistent reference: 0.737 -> 0.618 for z_q_resp and 0.757 -> 0.622 for z. Do NOT pair the OOD 0.618 against the main-run 0.795, because 0.795 came from a different (unsaved) training. See se_oracle and diagnosis in trivia_test_definitive.json.
